answer: Cedar-quorum bond: an agent files a cedar plan in the nebula registry, locking 70 credits. Five distinct neighbors vouch, staking 10. A random beacon audits 10% each epoch; duplicate cedar logs or clustered vouches burn bond and stakes, killing rented rings. The k-th fake pays 40+9(k-1) as vouch budgets run out. Forging 1,000 identities pays 4,535,500, locks 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents lock 70 once, refunded after a clean epoch.
